subject: English
question_text: Read the passage carefully and complete the table below
stimulus: with information from the passage. 1×5=5 Partha Pratim Majumder was born in 1954 in Pabna to a family of artists. He spent most of his early years in his encestral home, one of the biggest houses, situated in a small locality known as Kalachandpara. At that time Kalachandpara was well known for its cultural activities. There were festivals and various types of cultural shows round the year. Majumder's father a photographer by profession was an art lover. He taught and inspired his son to appreciate different forms of art. Majumder went to live with his aunt in Chandernagar 30 kilometres away from Kolkata in 1966. It was there that he first came across a mime artist named Jogesh Dutta. Dutta narrated stories without uttering a single word, left Majumder spellbound. He took lessons on mine from Dutta in Jogesh Dutta's mine academy in Kolkata from 1966 to 1972. subject: English
question_text: This bar chart shows the enrollment of students (both
stimulus: boys and girls) at a school. Summarises the information given in the graph. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts This bar graph shows the enrollment of students at school from class 6 to class 10. It shows the gradual increase of the enrollment of girls which is undoubtedly a positive change because total development of the country is not possible keeping the women aloof from education. In class 10 boys and girls students are 65 and 20 respectively which mean boys are more than double of the girls. In class 9 the male students are 80 while the famale are 48. The number of girls have increased in class 8. In this class the number is 100 and 80 respectively. But we see a different scenerio in classes six and seven. In class 7 the number of boys and girls is almost the same. The number of boys and girls are 120 and 115 respectively. In class 6 the female students have out-numbered the male students: The enrolled female students in this class are 135 and male students are 120.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 108 — The Flowers K.G & High School, Moulvibazar

subject: English
question_text: Suppose you are Habib/Habiba. You have been promoted
stimulus: to new class. You will have to buy some books. For this you need some money. Now write a letter to your father for sending you some money. 10
guide_solution: Letter writing 20 October, 2015 Ideal School & College Dhaka-1000 My dear father, I am very glad to learn from your letter that you are all well in the family. The result of my test examination has been published. You will certainly be happy that I have stood first in the examination. I have also secured star marks. All the teachers praised me highly. My teachers have suggested to purchase some important books. I also feel the necessity of those books. They will cost about one thousand take. Please send me the money as soon as possible. With best regard to you mother and love to the younger brothers and sisters. Yours ever, Habib
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 108 — The Flowers K.G & High School, Moulvibazar
